**About the job**

Go-To-Market Capabilities (GTMC) Hub is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in Hyderabad, India and is set up to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. GTMC strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi globally.

At our Sanofi we are leveraging analytics and technology, on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Within our Insights & Analytics organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.

Deliverables support planning and decision making across multiple functional areas such as finance, manufacturing, product development and commercial. In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across the franchise, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes.

* Partner with marketing, media, and commercial stakeholders to answer key business questions and support strategic decision making.

**Technical skills**

* Working knowledge of relational database concepts
* Hands-on experience with analytical tools such as SQL, Snowflake, Excel, Python, etc.
* Experience with data exploration, data preparation, and analytical modelling techniques, including regression and attribution analysis
* Knowledge of analytical and measurement methodologies, including segmentation techniques, attribution modelling (MTA), propensity score matching, incrementality strategies, lookalike modelling, frequency and sequencing modelling.
* Required experience working with omnichannel datasets including digital engagement, media, campaign, or customer interaction data.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical datasets (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, Veeva CRM, Salesforce) is preferred.
* Understanding of statistical concepts and methodologies, including descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, probability distributions, and experimental design, with the ability to apply them to business and marketing analytics.
* Exposure to predictive modelling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, decision trees, propensity models, clustering, or similar analytical approaches is preferred.
* Familiarity with marketing measurement frameworks, including attribution, incrementality testing, audience measurement, and campaign effectiveness evaluation.
* Preferred experience in data science techniques including machine learning, statistical modelling (i.e. logistic regression, GBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, propensity score matching, market mix modelling etc.), to generate predictive and prescriptive insights that drive the business strategic decision-making.
* Experience with AI/ML tools, generative AI, or Large Language Models (LLMs) is a plus.

---------------------

This role is responsible for analyzing current-state processes, identifying gaps, building business cases, supporting change management, maintaining backlog health, coordinating UAT, and establishing control plans that measure release success and monitor operational impacts after implementation. This role is within a fast-paced, highly matrixed enterprise function.

* Partner with product management, business stakeholders, operations, technology teams, and SMEs to understand objectives, business outcomes, customer impacts, and operational considerations.

About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
The Market Intelligence Analyst a key member of our fast-growing Corporate Marketing team and will work closely with third party databases along with marketing, sales and product teams to gain in-depth intelligence and insights into our customers’ planned trials, competitors, and key target markets.
  
  
The Market Intelligence Analyst is a results-oriented, analytical and methodical research leader who finds and interprets market, sales and competitive information to deliver the insights Signant Health needs to sustain and enable growth. This person will improve the focus and precision of our indication-specific, go to market strategies and plans while improving our competitive position and accelerating our target market penetration.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function
  
1. Provide regular ongoing analysis of the full clinical trial landscape using third party databases and company research; provide these analyses to inform marketing and sales focus at the indication and company level.
  
2. Develop deep dives and profiles on specific companies and compounds to help sales understand customer dynamics and identify opportunities to target.
  
3. Present research findings to sales team and other senior internal stakeholders.
  
4. Build and maintain a strong understanding of competitors and distill findings to marketing, sales and product.
  
5. Review investor presentations and meetings, and produce write-ups that distill key information for senior teams.
  
6. Work closely with sales in win/loss analysis and to understand regional differences in the competitive landscape.
  
7. Remain fully informed on analyst research and industry thought leaders. Present findings back to product marketing, sales and leadership team.
  
8. Working on adhoc strategic projects, including but not limited to assisting with the team with research, customer/marketplace diligence, and meeting coordination.
  
  
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  
1. 2 + years of demonstrated experience with both qualitative and quantitative market research skills, including but not limited to data analysis, competitive intelligence, data synthesis, SWOT analysis, and data driven recommendations.
  
2. 1 + years of experience working with clinical trial research tools; experience with GlobalData or TrialTrove a big plus.
  
3. Strong understanding of the drug-development and clinical-trials landscape.
  
4. Demonstrable ability to analyse company financial performance, clinical pipelines, competitor activity and wider market trends.
  
5. Strong quantitative skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables and analysis of large datasets.
  
6. Excellent written communication and the ability to distil complex research, earnings information and datasets into concise commercial insights.
  
7. Strong analytical judgement and the ability to draw conclusions from multiple quantitative and qualitative sources.
  
8. Ability to manage concurrent weekly, monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc deliverables while meeting time-sensitive deadlines.
  
9. High attention to detail and a rigorous approach to data quality and source validation.
  
10. Confidence working independently and engaging with senior commercial stakeholders.
  
11. Bachelor’s degree required.
  
12. Working knowledge of Microsoft Powerpoint.
  
  
**Desirable:**  
1. Experience analysing pharmaceutical clinical pipelines, therapeutic areas and probability/likelihood of approval.
  
2. Experience monitoring biotech funding, venture capital, IPOs, private placements and M&A activity.
  
3. Knowledge of the CRO market and competitive landscape.
  
4. Experience using FactSet, Salesforce and/or Power BI.
  
5. Experience analysing quarterly earnings, investor presentations and earnings-call transcripts.
  
6. Experience with Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar generative-AI platforms for structured research and analysis.

jobs.title: Manager III Business Intel
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead the Business Intelligence team that measures and improves the experience of Amazon's delivery partners. Your team's data shapes the work Amazon offers drivers, how Amazon pays them, and which delivery features launch.  
  
Some delivery partners drive for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), the businesses that run delivery routes for Amazon. Others choose blocks of work on their own schedule through Amazon Flex. Think about the questions behind a single day of deliveries. How many blocks should we offer next week, and will drivers pick them up? Is a route sized so the driver can finish on time? Did the driver get paid correctly? How long did they wait at the station? Was a package marked delivered that the customer never received, and did a change to the delivery app reduce those cases? What are drivers telling us in their feedback this week? Each answer depends on data that is accurate, complete and on time.  
  
We are bringing DSP and Amazon Flex analytics together under one leader, so both programs share one view of the delivery partner experience. You will lead through the team, developing engineers rather than doing the hard parts yourself. You will present to Director, VP and SVP audiences, so clear writing and executive presence are essential.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
A day in the life  
  
About the team  
We are the Last Mile Business Intelligence team. We partner with program, product, science, engineering, operations and finance leaders worldwide. Together we improve the experience of the people who deliver Amazon packages, and the customers who receive them. We share best practices across teams and use generative AI to automate reporting and analysis.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Lead, hire and develop a team of Business Intelligence Engineers. Give each engineer clear ownership and priorities, a growth plan, and coaching on how to approach hard problems.  
Own the metrics and business reviews for delivery quality, workload and earnings, payments, station experience and pickup quality, across DSP and Amazon Flex.  
Explain why defects happen and what to do about them. Use attribution models, A/B experiment readouts, and large language models that analyze driver and customer feedback.  
Set the quality bar for the team's data: freshness checks, monitoring, data security, and documented review before leadership use. Tell stakeholders in advance before any restatement.  
Set the team's analytical agenda and manage stakeholder expectations. Prioritize requests across programs, say no with a clear reason when needed, and keep stakeholders informed.  
  
A day in the life  
Our stakeholders work across time zones, so the day starts in the late morning and runs into the evening. You begin by reviewing the overnight data checks and a draft business review from one of your engineers. In the afternoon, you hold one-on-ones and plan an engineer's next stretch project. In the evening, you meet program, product and engineering partners in other regions. You agree how to measure an upcoming experiment, and tell stakeholders what is fixed, what is open and when.  
  
About the team  
We are the Last Mile Business Intelligence team. We partner with program, product, science, engineering, operations and finance leaders worldwide. Together we improve the experience of the people who deliver Amazon packages, and the customers who receive them. We share best practices across teams and use generative AI to automate reporting and analysis.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
* 5+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
* Experience in data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with R, Python, Weka, SAS, Matlab or other statistical/machine learning software

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4+ years of working with very large data warehousing environment experience
* Experience leading and influencing the BI strategy of your team or organization
* Experience in leveraging AI technologies for process automation and business problem solving

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - Cloud
jobs.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Product Owner - Cloud owns the backlog and roadmap for the Cloud platform, and all Cloud services translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Experience delivering Cloud Services as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Experience using Jira or a similar backlog management tool.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

jobs.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering local area network or wireless capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering campus network improvements that increased coverage, user experience or reliability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Product Owner qualification, such as SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, Juniper EX or Juniper Mist.
* Experience with network assurance, Internet of Things or operational technology connectivity.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst - AI Framework
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Owner (PO) for AI & Agentic Products** to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio. In this role, you will be the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens — determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories. Define clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define "what success looks like" for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* Solid conceptual understanding of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. You don't need to code it, but you must know how it works
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the return on investment (ROI) of automation features
* Comfort with managing product lifecycles for non-deterministic software (where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable)
* Extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments, using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Proven track record of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases (MVP approach)
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

This role requires deep expertise in functional analysis, with demonstrated strengths in information architecture and/or Data architecture.

This role is focused on deep discovery, problem framing, requirements facilitation, and translating business needs into clear, actionable functional and data requirements. You will partner closely with business stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and end‑to‑end processes, while also diving deep into data nuances, edge cases, and dependencies.

The role is accountable for proactively identifying gaps and ambiguities, designing conceptual and functional solutions before technical implementation begins, and partnering with engineering teams to shepherd solutions through delivery.

* Act as the primary functional analyst on complex, cross-functional‑ data initiatives.
* Lead requirements elicitation and facilitation through workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder interviews.
* Translate business objectives, constraints, and pain points into clear, structured, and testable functional and data requirements (e.g., BRDs, functional designs, epics, acceptance criteria).

jobs.description:
Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner
  
  
One role
  
  

* Contract-to-hire
* India

Role summary
  
  
You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases.
* Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them.
* Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on.
* Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain.
* Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off.
* Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers.
* Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed.
* Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks.
* Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next.
* Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners.

What we are looking for
  
  
Critical (must have)
  
  

* Communication. You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up.
* Business understanding. You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact.
* Technical skill. You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analyst's work. Snowflake experience is preferred.

Also required
  
  

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role.
* Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders.
* Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules.
* Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific.

Nice to have
  
  

* Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience.
* Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service).
* Experience with data catalog or governance tools.
* Power BI or another BI tool.
* Agile and Azure DevOps.

What success looks like in the first 90 days
  
  

* Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains.
* The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners.
* A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**About Cogentiq CX**
---------------------

Cogentiq CX is Fractal’s enterprise contact center AI platform, purpose-built for regulated industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare. It combines voice and chat automation, agent assist, and agentic AI workflows to help enterprises resolve customer interactions faster without compromising compliance, security, or customer trust.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and delivery of key capabilities across Cogentiq CX’s voice, chat, and agentic AI stack. You’ll work with engineering, AI/ML, solutions, sales, and customer success to turn customer problems into products that run in production in demanding enterprise contact centers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for voice and chat automation and agentic AI capabilities
* Translate enterprise customer needs, pilot learnings, and market signals into clear PRDs, user stories, and prioritized backlogs
* Drive design of agentic experiences: orchestration, tool and API integration, guardrails, escalation to human agents, and evaluation frameworks
* Define success metrics (containment, resolution rate, AHT, CSAT, latency, hallucination and compliance rates) and use them to guide iteration
* Partner with engineering and AI teams on architecture trade-offs across ASR/TTS, LLMs, telephony, and CCaaS integrations
* Work with pre-sales, FDEs, and customer success on pilots, POCs, and RFx responses, and carry the learnings back into the product
* Support go-to-market with positioning, demos, sales enablement, and analyst/partner conversations
* Track the competitive landscape (CCaaS vendors, conversational AI platforms, voice AI startups) and sharpen differentiation
* Ensure products meet the security, privacy, and compliance expectations of regulated industries

### **What You Bring**

**Must have**

* 7+ years in product management, with 3+ years on contact center, conversational AI, or CX products
* Hands-on experience shipping voice and/or chat products (IVR modernization, voicebots, chatbots, virtual agents, agent assist)
* Working knowledge of agentic AI: LLM-based agents, tool use, RAG, orchestration, prompt design, and evaluation and guardrails
* Familiarity with the contact center ecosystem: CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Avaya, etc.), telephony/SIP, CRM and ticketing integrations
* Experience with enterprise B2B products, including long sales cycles, pilots-to-production, and complex stakeholder environments
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with metrics, experimentation, and data-driven prioritization
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical teams and C-level buyers

**Good to have**

* Prior experience with regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) and related compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, data residency)
* Background in classical NLP/NLU (intent and entity models, dialog management) and experience through the shift to GenAI
* Experience with real-time voice challenges: latency, barge-in, turn-taking, multilingual and accent handling
* Exposure to observability, QA, and analytics tooling for conversational systems
* Technical background (engineering or data science) or comfort reading API docs and reviewing architecture
* Experience with partner and marketplace integrations

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

We are looking for an ambitious, systems-thinking, and highly analytical Product Manager to take ownership of our foundational cash management, treasury, and settlement ecosystem. As our transaction volume scales, the complexity of moving money efficiently, securely, and reliably becomes paramount.
  
  
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the core systems that govern optimal liquidity, power seamless financial operations, and establish direct integrations with central payment networks. You will navigate complex regulatory and technical landscapes, starting with optimizing our daily liquidity and settlement operations. Over time, you will spearhead the evolution of this function from an operational backbone into a highly strategic, value-generating engine that optimizes our working capital and financial intelligence.

* Enable Financial Intelligence: Create product features and tools that empower our finance and treasury teams with advanced cash flow forecasting, real-time visibility, and strategic capital optimization.

* Strategic Execution: A strong bias for action with the ability to balance immediate operational requirements with long-term, highly scalable platform architecture.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You will need to collaborate seamlessly with and influence engineering, finance, treasury operations, and legal/compliance teams.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tokenisation & Stablecoin Infrastructure
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
* Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.
* Scope and ship new issuer and asset integrations end to end: write PRDs, define order, fee, and settlement flows, align on custody and security models, and drive launch readiness.
* Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
* Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
* Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
* Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
* Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.
* Mentor junior PMs and help raise the bar for product craft within the team.

**Who Would Be a Great Fit**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, crypto, or financial infrastructure, with a record of shipping B2B or institutional products.
* Strong working knowledge of crypto and blockchain: token standards and mechanics, multiple L1/L2 ecosystems, wallets and custody, and onchain settlement.
* Understanding of stablecoin and tokenization models: issuance, mint/burn and redemption, reserves, fiat on/off-ramps, and how tokenized funds, securities, or deposits work.
* Familiarity with the regulatory landscape for stablecoins and digital assets (such as GENIUS Act, MiCA, and trust-bank or custody regulation) and the ability to work through it with legal and compliance partners.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to coordinate engineering, business, and external partners and to build consensus in ambiguous areas.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to write clear PRDs and explain complex technical or regulatory topics to executives and clients.
* Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing several projects with different priorities and a hands-on approach to execution.
* Prior startup or scale-up experience, showing adaptability, ownership, and sound judgment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in traditional finance, capital markets, asset management, or banking infrastructure (custody, settlement, transfer agency).
* Hands-on exposure to institutional tokenization networks or permissioned chains.
* Technical background or comfort reading APIs, smart contracts, and architecture docs.
* Experience with enterprise partnerships and client-facing product work.

**Why Join BitGo?**
Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of open communication, collaboration, accountability, craftsmanship, and a client first approach. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.
  
  
Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:
  
  

* Competitive salary
* IT equipment support for work
* Meal & commute allowance
* Medical insurance
* Attractive well-being allowance (covering medical, wellness, and fitness)
* Snacks on the house in the Bangalore office
* A great, talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed finance.
  
  
**Note:**
This role requires working onsite (Monday to Friday) at the Bangalore office.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.**
Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.**
Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.**
Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.**
Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.**
  Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.**
  Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.**
  Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.**
  Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.**
  Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**Informa** is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis** is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you. Our teams are solving unique and difficult problems at scale in an energetic and hyper-growth environment. We’re growing incredibly quickly, and we need experienced technical people to help us scale.

 **Job Description**

**Job role:**

We are currently hiring for the role of **Service Analyst** to add to our **Technology team** based out of Bengaluru, India. This role will report into the Team Lead - Service Management Operations.

* Experience in an IT operations support environment supporting global users.
* Good knowledge of MS Office applications, especially the Office 365 suite of products.
* Good hands-on knowledge on ticketing tool like ServiceNow or any other similar tool.
* Good professionalism approach and etiquette, being proactive, good documentation skills.
* Good self-organising skills including regular planning of daily tasks and delivering with focus on quality and on time; able to be flexible to changing business requirements.
* Exposure to and/or awareness of IT Service Management frameworks such as ITIL is good to have.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Good analytical ability, attention to detail, and ability to present reports and metrics.
* Can demonstrate good problem-solving abilities.
* Be able to adjust communication style and format as appropriate for staff at all levels.
* Be able to translate business impacts into functional and/or technical requirements.

**Desired:**

* Experience with Academic, Publishing domain, business processes, and operational environment.

jobs.description:
Senior Developer

Capgemini development team • module owner • AI-native • C# / .NET

Role summary

A senior C# engineer who owns one or more delivery slices end to end design, build, tests, deployment to QA and Pre-Production, integration with third-party systems, and business review — and is accountable for the result working on integration, not merely passing in isolation. Works evaluation- and test-driven, uses agentic AI development tools as the default way of working, and holds the flow and quality disciplines of the team without exception. There is no testing team to hand quality to.

Working context

The team is small and senior by design. Where work is well-specified, AI-augmented engineers are expected to deliver materially more every two weeks than a conventional team; where work is ambiguous — interpreting a plan rule, judging a country's payment logic — the constraint is the engineer's judgment, and AI adds nothing.

Quality is not a phase and not a department. Each senior developer owns the entire range of work for a slice: the code, the tests that prove it, the integration behavior, the documentation, and the board that shows where it is. Nothing is handed off to a testing team in the traditional way; the Senior Quality Architect designs the quality system, but the developer is accountable for the outcome inside it.

Part of the work is inheriting and evaluating an existing codebase built by the previous team through the forfeiture stage. Not all of it will be kept.

Key responsibilities

* End-to-end slice ownership. Take a slice from acceptance criteria to a working, integrated increment in Pre-Production. 'Done' means it works against the real interfaces or their contract-verified stubs, its tests gate the pipeline, its documentation is current and the business has seen it in a demo window — not that it compiled.
* Evaluation- and test-driven development. Write the evaluation criteria and tests before or alongside the code, for every change: unit, contract (Pact) and end-to-end (Playwright). Use the same discipline for AI-generated code — define what correct looks like first, then generate, then verify.
* Accountable for integration. Own the behavior of your slice across the interfaces it touches — SAP H1P, PeopleConnect, Clarity, Zurich, ASC, Alight/Empower, the primary bank. Contract tests first, then joint test windows with the third party's technical contact. An integration defect in your slice is your defect.
* Trunk-based delivery. Merge to trunk many times a day behind feature flags; keep the pipeline green; deploy to QA on every merge and to UAT / Pre-Production several times a week. A red pipeline is the first priority for whoever broke it.
* Flow discipline. Maintain the Kanban board as the true state of your work — every day, without being asked. Respect WIP limits, keep items moving, flag blocked work immediately, and keep work documentation (design notes, decisions, test evidence) current as part of the slice, not after it.
* Programming standards and code quality. Apply the team's programming standards on every change and hold others to them in review. Keep SonarQube quality gates green — coverage, duplication, maintainability, reliability and security ratings — and treat a failed gate as a blocker, not a warning.
* Inherited code. Evaluate the existing IBIS 2.0 modules — through the forfeiture stage — against the target architecture, the SonarQube baseline and the quality bar; remediate, refactor or replace with a documented rationale.
* Multi-country rules. Implement plan rules and payment logic so that country-specific behavior is configuration rather than code branches, working with the Rules & Country Config Lead and the business SMEs.
* Business collaboration. Demonstrate working software to the Product Owner and business SMEs in the Tuesday and Thursday demo windows; turn their feedback into backlog items the same week.
* Review. Review other engineers' changes with the same rigor applied to your own; act as reviewer of record on every merge you approve. AI review is a second pass, never the gate.

Required skills and experience

* 9+ years professional software engineering with C# as the primary language; 3+ years building and operating .NET microservices in production.
* Very comfortable with agentic AI development tools as the default way of working — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode or equivalent — including context and prompt management for a large codebase.
* Evaluation-driven and test-driven design and development as an ingrained practice, not a preference: defines what correct looks like before writing or generating code.
* Highly quality-oriented: demonstrable history of owning the full range of work for a feature and being accountable for it working on integration, in a team with no separate test function.
* Strong flow discipline: keeps Kanban boards accurate daily, respects WIP limits, documents work as it happens, applies programming standards consistently — and expects the same of peers.
* Working proficiency with SonarQube (or equivalent) as part of the definition of done: reads and acts on quality-gate results, coverage, code smells and security hotspots.
* Automated testing across the pyramid: unit frameworks (xUnit / NUnit), consumer-driven contract testing (Pact), browser end-to-end (Playwright).
* Trunk-based development with feature flags and continuous delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
* Cloud-native delivery on GCP (or Azure / AWS with a willingness to work on GCP): containers, managed data services, secrets and identity.
* API design and enterprise integration patterns; experience integrating with SAP or another large ERP.
* Comfortable demonstrating working software to non-technical business users and taking direct feedback.

Agentic AI expectations

* Works AI-first on well-specified tasks: implementation from acceptance criteria, test generation, data mapping, migration scripts, documentation …

Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes, data integrations, and governed datasets that support product and business reporting.  
Develop reporting, dashboards, and analytics that help Product and business teams understand performance, customer behavior, product usage, and operational trends.  
The ideal candidate combines strong SQL, data transformation, reporting, and analytical skills with the ability to work across multiple data sources and translate business needs into scalable data solutions. Experience with data science, machine learning, or AI is valuable but not required.

During the first 12 months, this person will be expected to:

* Build or improve scalable ETL/ELT processes that combine key product and business data sources.
* Improve the accuracy, accessibility, and automation of product and business reporting.
* Deliver dashboards and analytical datasets that provide teams with more granular and actionable insights into product usage, adoption, customers, and business performance.
* Establish reusable data models, metrics, and validation processes that improve reporting consistency and data quality.
* Reduce manual effort required to produce recurring reports and analyses.
* Build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business teams.

* **Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, information systems, engineering, statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.**
* **3–5 years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data analytics, or a related field.**
* **Strong proficiency in SQL, including querying, joining, transforming, and validating complex datasets.**
* **Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating data from multiple sources.**
* **Experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets used by business stakeholders.**
* **Strong understanding of data modeling, transformation, data quality, and metric definition.**
* **Experience working with structured data across multiple systems or platforms.**
* **Ability to translate ambiguous business or product requirements into scalable data and reporting solutions.**
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
* **Experience collaborating with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

  

* Experience using Python for data transformation, automation, or advanced analytics.
* Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data and analytics platforms.
